about: Where text may sit, per format, in px from each edge. Photos and clips run full bleed; type and the guide cards stay inside. reel follows the Reels interface (top 14% for the header, bottom 35% for the caption and audio bar, the right edge for the action rail), so a card shown in the film sits inside it; guide is the 1080x1350 card, whose body keeps an 80 px margin.
